name: unity-semantic-graph-presentations
description: Presentation sources for Unity Semantic Graph for CCK

scripts.generate:diagrams: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('assets/generated',{recursive:true})" && mmdc --puppeteerConfigFile puppeteer-config.json --input diagrams/repository-flow.mmd --output assets/generated/repository-flow.svg --backgroundColor transparent
scripts.build:pdf: npm run generate:diagrams && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true})" && marp slides/repository-overview.md --pdf --allow-local-files --output dist/repository-overview.pdf
